decisions.statement: The folders are cleared before any link is placed.
The units are kept after the links are placed.
Nothing here draws a picture for the editor.
A folder left with nothing by a path the repository ignores is cleared off the disk.
A folder is linked for a page that moved rather than for every page there is.
A page no move carries has the folder it sits in linked by nothing.
A link that could not be placed is answered rather than refusing the landing.
A unit that could not be kept is answered rather than refusing the landing.
A landing that committed nothing is finished the same way.
Nothing here refuses a landing that has already committed.
Nothing here writes a body the change carries.

definition: the work a landing does once its commit has landed
